subject: A new device signed in to your account
body:
Hi Jordan,

We noticed a sign-in to your account from a new device (iPhone, Seattle WA) on Sep 5 at 6:28 PM. If this was you, no action is needed.

If you don't recognize this activity, open the Harborline app or type harborlinebank.com directly into your browser to review your account.

Harborline Bank
